name: humanize-intcomma-default-preserves-integers-control
rationale: humanize 4.16.0 documents intcomma as inserting separators into an integer. The independent oracle groups decimal digits without float conversion or numeric formatting. This control uses the identical signed 64-bit input domain as intcomma-zero-digits.json but leaves ndigits at its default None. Official contract: https://humanize.readthedocs.io/en/stable/number/#humanize.number.intcomma .
domain: Python int inputs from -2**63 through 2**63-1, default English locale, ndigits=None. Excludes floats, fractions, strings, custom locales and integers outside this bound.
